title: Part 3 對話＋表格資訊整合與動名詞／不定詞進階

sections.title: Day 19 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天接續 Day 18，正式進入 **Part 3「對話＋表格」資訊整合**。這是第三週的重要升級：你不只要聽懂對話，還要把聽到的「條件」帶進表格才能得到答案。

文法進入 **動名詞與不定詞進階**：`remember / forget / stop / try / regret`。這些動詞後面接 `V-ing` 或 `to V` 都可能正確，但**意思不同**。

目前沒有收到 Day 18 實際成績，因此今天維持 **860～900 分難度**。今天先不再增加三人對話複雜度，而是把難度放在「跨來源整合」。

建議訓練時間：**95～105 分鐘**。

sections.title: ① 今日單字｜30 個
sections.markdown:
主題：**Travel / Transportation / Business Trips**

| 單字 | 中文 | TOEIC 高頻搭配 |

| departure | 出發 | departure time |
| arrival | 抵達 | arrival time |
| destination | 目的地 | final destination |
| itinerary | 行程 | travel itinerary |
| reservation | 預訂 | make a reservation |
| accommodation | 住宿 | arrange accommodation |
| transportation | 交通 | public transportation |
| fare | 車資、票價 | train fare |
| passenger | 乘客 | airline passenger |
| terminal | 航廈 | airport terminal |
| platform | 月台 | train platform |
| boarding | 登機 | boarding pass |
| luggage | 行李 | claim luggage |
| baggage | 行李 | baggage claim |
| delay | 延誤 | flight delay |
| delayed | 延誤的 | delayed flight |
| cancel | 取消 | cancel a flight |
| cancellation | 取消 | flight cancellation |
| postpone | 延後 | postpone a trip |
| reschedule | 改期 | reschedule a flight |
| transfer | 轉乘 | transfer to another train |
| connection | 轉乘班次 | connecting flight |
| direct | 直達的 | direct flight |

| advance | 提前 | book in advance |

| reimbursement | 報銷 | travel reimbursement |
| expense | 費用 | travel expenses |
| receipt | 收據 | keep a receipt |
| convenient | 方便的 | convenient location |

今天優先形成：

> **departure time**  
> **travel itinerary**  
> **arrange accommodation**  
> **boarding pass**  
> **baggage claim**  
> **flight delay**  
> **connecting flight**  
> **direct flight**  
> **book in advance**  
> **travel expenses**

注意：

`luggage` 和 `baggage` 通常都是不可數：

> some luggage ✅  
> a piece of luggage ✅  
> several pieces of luggage ✅

不是：

> luggages ❌

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜remember doing vs. remember to do
sections.markdown:
先比較：

> I remember **meeting** Mr. Chen.

意思：

**我記得以前見過陳先生。**

事情已經發生。

而：

> Remember **to call** Mr. Chen.

意思：

**記得要打電話給陳先生。**

事情尚未完成。

所以：

> remember + V-ing  
> → 記得「做過」

> remember + to V  
> → 記得「要做」

sections.title: ③ forget doing vs. forget to do
sections.markdown:
邏輯相同。

> I'll never forget **visiting** Paris.

= 我永遠不會忘記曾經去過巴黎。

但是：

> I forgot **to submit** the report.

= 我忘記要交報告。

結果：

**沒有交。**

TOEIC 更常考：

> forget to V

例如：

> Don't forget _____ your receipt.

(A) keeping  
(B) to keep

答案：

**B**

因為是提醒未來要做。

sections.title: ④ stop doing vs. stop to do
sections.markdown:
這組非常重要。

> He stopped **working**.

意思：

**他停止工作。**

原本正在 working，現在不做了。

但：

> He stopped **to answer** the phone.

意思：

**他停下原本正在做的事情，去接電話。**

所以：

> stop + V-ing  
> = 停止這件事

> stop + to V  
> = 停下來，為了做另一件事

sections.title: ⑤ try doing vs. try to do
sections.markdown:
### try to V

表示：

**努力、試圖完成某件事**

> I tried **to contact** the supplier, but no one answered.

我有努力聯絡，但可能沒成功。

### try V-ing

表示：

**試試某個方法**

> If the printer doesn't work, try **restarting** it.

意思：

> 試試重新啟動看看。

這在 TOEIC 辦公設備情境非常常用。

sections.title: ⑥ regret doing vs. regret to do
sections.markdown:
### regret doing

後悔已經做過：

> We regret **causing** the inconvenience.

### regret to V

很正式的商務英文：

> We regret **to inform** you that your flight has been canceled.

意思不是：

「我們後悔通知你。」

而是：

**很遺憾地通知您……**

常見：

> We regret to inform you that...

商務通知、拒絕信非常高頻。

sections.title: ⑦ 今天的秒判表
sections.markdown:
| 結構 | 意思 |
|---|---|
| remember doing | 記得做過 |
| remember to do | 記得要做 |
| forget doing | 忘記曾做過 |
| forget to do | 忘記要做 |
| stop doing | 停止做 |
| stop to do | 停下來去做另一件事 |
| try doing | 試試某方法 |
| try to do | 努力去做 |
| regret doing | 後悔做過 |
| regret to do | 遺憾地要做／通知 |

今天不要背成「哪個動詞後面接 V-ing」。

因為：

> **兩種都可以，意思不同。**

sections.title: ⑧ Part 3 圖表整合｜解題方法
sections.markdown:
今天第一次正式做：

**聽力＋表格。**

看到表格，不要全部背。

先讀題目，例如：

> Which train will the speakers probably take?

再看表格：

| Train | Departure | Arrival |
|---|---:|---:|
| 102 | 8:10 | 9:25 |
| 118 | 8:45 | 10:00 |
| 126 | 9:20 | 10:35 |
| 134 | 10:00 | 11:15 |

你只需要知道：

> 題目要找「哪一班」。

接著 Listening 如果說：

> We need to arrive before 10:30, but I can't leave the office until 8:30.

把兩個條件帶入：

**8:30 後才能出發**

排除 102。

**10:30 前抵達**

排除 126、134。

因此：

> **118**

這種題的答案不是直接「聽」出來，而是：

> **Listening 條件 + Graphic 資訊 = 答案**

sections.title: ⑨ Listening｜Part 3 + 表格 1
sections.markdown:
### Train Schedule

| Train | Departure | Arrival |
|---|---:|---:|
| 205 | 8:00 | 9:15 |
| 217 | 8:40 | 9:55 |
| 229 | 9:10 | 10:25 |
| 241 | 9:45 | 11:00 |

先看題目。

### Q1

Why are the speakers traveling?

(A) To attend a meeting  
(B) To inspect a factory  
(C) To visit a customer  
(D) To attend training

### Q2

What constraint does the woman mention?

(A) She cannot leave before 8:30  
(B) She needs to return before noon  
(C) She has lost her ticket  
(D) She needs a direct flight

### Q3

Look at the table. Which train will they most likely take?

(A) 205  
(B) 217  
(C) 229  
(D) 241

聽力稿：

> **Man:** Which train should we take to Taichung for tomorrow's client meeting?
>
> **Woman:** The meeting starts at ten thirty, so I'd like to arrive at least thirty minutes early. But I have to finish a conference call here at eight fifteen.
>
> **Man:** In that case, the 8:40 train looks best. I'll book the tickets.
>
> **Woman:** Great. Please reserve seats near the front if they're available.

答案：

**1A / 2A / 3B**

Q3 可以直接聽到 8:40，但仍要確認表格：

> 8:40 = Train **217**

正式 TOEIC 有些題目不會直接說班號，只給時間。

sections.title: ⑩ Listening｜Part 3 + 表格 2
sections.markdown:
### Airport Shuttle

| Shuttle | Departure | Terminal |
|---|---:|---|
| A | 6:30 | Terminal 1 |
| B | 7:00 | Terminal 2 |
| C | 7:30 | Terminal 1 |
| D | 8:00 | Terminal 2 |

### Q1

Where are the speakers probably going?

(A) A conference center  
(B) An airport  
(C) A factory  
(D) A restaurant

### Q2

What does the woman say about her flight?

(A) It has been canceled  
(B) It departs from Terminal 2  
(C) It leaves tomorrow  
(D) It has been delayed

### Q3

Look at the table. Which shuttle will the woman most likely take?

(A) A  
(B) B  
(C) C  
(D) D

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** My flight boards at eight fifteen, so I should probably take the seven o'clock shuttle.
>
> **Man:** Which terminal are you leaving from?
>
> **Woman:** Terminal 2. I checked my boarding pass this morning.
>
> **Man:** Then seven o'clock should work. It usually takes about thirty minutes to get there.

答案：

**1B / 2B / 3B**

表格：

> 7:00 + Terminal 2

→ Shuttle **B**

sections.title: ⑪ Listening｜Part 3 推論
sections.markdown:
### Q1

Why is the man calling?

(A) To change a reservation  
(B) To apply for a job  
(C) To request a refund  
(D) To confirm a meeting

### Q2

What problem does he mention?

(A) His flight arrives later than expected  
(B) His hotel room is unavailable  
(C) His luggage is missing  
(D) His meeting was canceled

### Q3

What will the woman probably do?

(A) Cancel the reservation  
(B) Change the check-in information  
(C) Contact an airline  
(D) Issue a refund

聽力稿：

> **Man:** Hi, I have a reservation for tonight under Daniel Lee. My flight has been delayed by three hours, so I probably won't arrive until after eleven.
>
> **Woman:** That's no problem. I'll add a note to your reservation so the night staff knows you'll be checking in late.
>
> **Man:** Thank you. I was worried my room might be given away.

答案：

**1D / 2A / 3B**

注意 Q1。

他不是要：

> change the room

真正目的是：

> **確認晚到不會失去預訂。**

選項中最接近：

**confirm a reservation**

sections.title: ⑫ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
今天限時：

**3 分 30 秒。**

> **To:** All Sales Representatives  
> **From:** Corporate Travel Department  
> **Subject:** Updated Business Travel Policy
>
> Beginning October 1, employees traveling on company business should make airline and hotel reservations through the company's online travel portal.
>
> Whenever possible, flights should be booked at least 14 days in advance. Employees who need to make a reservation less than 14 days before departure must receive approval from their department manager.
>
> Travelers should remember to keep all receipts for transportation, accommodation, and other approved business expenses. Electronic copies may be uploaded through the expense reporting system.
>
> Employees are encouraged to use public transportation when it is more economical than taking a taxi. However, taxi fares may be reimbursed when public transportation is unavailable or when employees are carrying large amounts of company equipment.
>
> After returning from a business trip, employees must submit an expense report within ten business days. Reports submitted after this period may require additional approval.

### Q1

When does the new policy take effect?

(A) September 14  
(B) October 1  
(C) October 10  
(D) October 14

### Q2

What should employees generally do with flights?

(A) Book at least 14 days early  
(B) Purchase tickets at the airport  
(C) Choose the most expensive option  
(D) Travel only on weekends

### Q3

What is required for a late reservation?

(A) Customer approval  
(B) Manager approval  
(C) A paper receipt  
(D) An additional hotel booking

### Q4

Why should travelers keep receipts?

(A) To change their flights  
(B) To receive reimbursement for approved expenses  
(C) To prove their identity  
(D) To reserve accommodation

### Q5

When may a taxi fare be reimbursed?

(A) Whenever an employee prefers taxis  
(B) Only during international travel  
(C) When public transportation is unavailable  
(D) Only when traveling with a manager

### Q6

How soon after a trip should an expense report normally be submitted?

(A) Within 5 calendar days  
(B) Within 10 business days  
(C) Within 14 days  
(D) Within one month

### Q7

In the sentence “Travelers should **remember to keep** all receipts,” why is `to keep` used?

(A) Keeping the receipts happened in the past  
(B) It refers to an action travelers need to remember to perform  
(C) The travelers stopped keeping receipts  
(D) Keeping receipts is optional

**答案：1B / 2A / 3B / 4B / 5C / 6B / 7B**

sections.title: ⑭ 幾題最容易錯的解析
sections.markdown:
Q4：

> stopped **operating the machine**

= 停止操作機器。

如果：

> stopped **to operate the machine**

則是：

「停下原本的事情，去操作機器。」

完全不同。

---

Q5：

> stopped **to get some coffee**

表示：

原本正在做別的事情：

→ 停下來

→ 去買／拿咖啡。

所以 `to get`。

---

Q6：

> try **restarting**

情境是：

> 電腦程式有問題。

這是在提供：

**可以試試看的解決方法。**

所以：

> try V-ing

---

Q7：

> tried **to contact**

後面：

> but the telephone number was incorrect

代表他：

**試圖聯絡，但沒有成功。**

所以：

> try to V

---

Q8：

> We regret **to inform you** that...

正式商務固定用法：

> **很遺憾通知您……**

sections.title: ⑯ 今日錯題判讀
sections.markdown:
如果 Q1～Q5 錯：

標記：

**G — Gerund / Infinitive Meaning**

不要只記正確答案。

例如 Q3 錯，筆記寫：

> stop doing = 停止原本的動作

如果 Q6～Q10 錯：

再分兩種。

如果「對話知道意思，但表格找錯」：

> **I — Information Integration**

如果「連對話中的條件都沒有抓到」：

> **L — Listening**

從今天開始新增 `I` 類型，因為 Part 3/4 圖表題的問題不一定是英文聽不懂，也可能是資訊整合速度不足。

sections.title: ⑱ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天單字不要逐字背，集中複習：

> departure time  
> travel itinerary  
> boarding pass  
> baggage claim  
> flight delay  
> connecting flight  
> direct flight  
> book in advance  
> travel expenses  
> arrange accommodation

接著把今天五組文法自己說出意思：

> remember doing ↔ remember to do

> forget doing ↔ forget to do

> stop doing ↔ stop to do

> try doing ↔ try to do

> regret doing ↔ regret to do

其中最優先熟悉：

> **stop doing / stop to do**

以及：

> **try doing / try to do**

Listening 則不要重聽整段後逐句翻譯。把第一段只留下：

> **meeting 10:30 → call until 8:15 → arrive before 10 → Train 217**

第二段：

> **flight 8:15 → Terminal 2 → 7:00 → Shuttle B**

這就是圖表題正確的筆記方式：

> **只記會影響表格選擇的條件。**

最後重新完成 Day 19 小考，第二次限制：

**2 分鐘。**

目標：

**10/10。**

若第一次達到 **9～10/10**，接下來會繼續維持 900 分方向，把表格題從「時間表」提升到「價目表／產品規格／行程表」並增加同義改寫；若 Q6～Q10 錯兩題以上，則先增加一輪表格定位訓練再提高複雜度。

**Day 19 核心：圖表題不是先把表格全部記起來，而是先從對話抓「限制條件」，再用條件去篩表格。**

Day 20 將進入 **Part 4 簡短獨白入門：公告、電話留言與公司通知**；文法會進入 **假設語氣與條件句進階 `if / unless / provided that / as long as`**，Listening 也會第一次從「多人對話」轉向「單人連續資訊」。
